value.description: Structured-clone values: null, boolean, finite number, UTF-8 string, signed/unsigned 64-bit bigint, ordinary ArrayBuffer or exact Uint8Array, arrays and plain own-data records. No SharedArrayBuffer, accessors, symbols, cycles, repeated object aliases, detached/resizable or sliced buffers. Depth <= 32; nodes <= 4096; charged encoded bytes include framing.

protocol.description: Every message repeats the exact binding and has no unknown fields. Parent: init(port, actorId); load(bytes,sha256); invoke(sequence,path,args); close. Child: ready; loaded(byteLength,sha256); result(sequence,value); transferred(sequence,detached); rejected(sequence); fault. One monotonically increasing sequence and one pending invocation. No effect-resolution or capability-bearing message exists in this deny-all bridge.
